title: Ferric Manipulations
subtitle: Ferric - blood remembers iron
text: Ferric tendency is borne by practitioners who have worked extensively with metal: smiths, miners, soldiers. Sanguine Mending (QUICK, 150): push blood into damaged held gear, repairing it cheaply. Sanguine Excavation (QUICK, 400): extend the iron in your blood outward through stone, breaking ore and rock in a radius. Ferric Resonance (QUICK, 600): set blood-iron ringing through body and equipment for a short burst of work and combat. Ferric Transmutation (QUICK, 1000): transmute metal through the medium of blood.
